searchText: Will #4 occur at the time of the merge or when withdrawals are later enabled? When withdrawals are enabled. you mean the the private key for the withdrawal credential is needed? why aren't we adding that at the time of merge, giving more of a chance to people who'se seeds have been compormised a chance to set things to a new address before withdrawals are actually enabled and start occuring if seeds were compromised, it doesn't matter when the change of credential feature is added because at that point, it's a race between you and the attacker and "why" -- the feature is relatively nascent in design and the Merge is committed to being minimal to get it done i see well thank you for the response and explanation! See also https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4736 on the topic of "how to help those with compromised seeds"
